description:
## Problem
`acquire_semaphore` in `Fetcher` catches any exception (`rescue ex`) and returns `false`, giving a generic 'Semaphore acquire failed' message with no trace of the real exception. If the channel is closed or there's a programming error (NilAssertionError), it's silently swallowed.

```crystal
rescue ex
  @config.error("fetch_single(#{url})", "Semaphore acquire failed: #{ex.message}")
  false
```

## File
- `src/vug/fetcher.cr` (lines 203-210)

## Fix
Catch only expected exception types (e.g., `Channel::ClosedError`). Re-raise unexpected exceptions. At minimum, include the exception class in the error message.

## Acceptance
- Unexpected exceptions (NilAssertionError, etc.) propagate correctly
- Expected exceptions (Channel::ClosedError) still return false gracefully
- Existing tests pass
title: Fix bare rescue in Semaphore#acquire_semaphore that swallows unexpected exceptions
